description_en: Initiates a real-person identity verification request
kebab_example: aliyun facebody gen-real-person-verification-token --certificate-name '张三' --certificate-number 33010219001123123X --meta-info dwe_:_ew4e_... --api-version 2019-12-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenRealPersonVerificationToken

parameters.help_en: The name on the ID card to be verified
parameters.name: certificate_name

parameters.help_en: The metainfo environment parameter, which must be obtained through the client SDK. For Android SDK, use getMetaInfos. For iOS SDK, use getMetaInfo
parameters.help_zh: metainfo环境参数，需要通过客户端SDK获取。Android SDK通过getMetaInfos获取，iOS SDK通过getMetaInfo获取
parameters.name: meta_info

VerificationToken.description_en:
The unique identifier for the trusted real-person verification.

If you do not perform a real-person verification mobile query after the mobile request, there will be no liveness or risk control results, and the overall verification carries certain risks. We recommend that you perform a [real-person verification mobile query]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198724.html） after the mobile request to complete the overall verification process.
The verificationToken returned by the real-person verification mobile request API is valid for 30 minutes from the time it is generated. If you perform face verification after the token expires, an error is returned. Complete the verification within the validity period
VerificationToken.description_zh:
可信核身认证的唯一标识。

核身认证移动端请求后未进行核身认证移动端查询就没有活体和风控结果，整体认证存在一定风险，建议移动端请求结束后进行[核身认证移动端查询]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198724.html），完成整体认证流程。
调用核身认证移动端请求接口返回的verificationToken有效期时间为30分钟，从verificationToken生成时间开始算起，超过有效期再进行人脸认证会报错，请在有效期时间内完成认证
